notes.title: Update Notes 5 – Training Fixes, Story-Rank Algorithms
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Toorun12, developer of 東方凸凹遊戯.

Today’s update includes a few changes based on player feedback. Let’s take a look:

Can’t select your character in Training Mode?
You're right—that felt a bit strange.
You can now choose your character when entering Training Mode!
Also, your highest ”LEVEL” reached during training will now be recorded.

Highlighted records were incorrect?
In some modes, the highlighted rankings or scores didn’t match the actual record you achieved.
This has now been fixed.

Story Mode final rank felt too harsh?
Previously, the final rank in Story Mode was based solely on your lowest rank across all stages.
Now, if you've achieved high ranks like A or S in some stages, your final rank will be slightly relaxed to reflect that.

That’s all for this update.
If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to let us know!

We’re also accepting improvement ideas on the official Discord server.
Come join if you're interested!

Thanks again, and we’ll keep working hard for the next update!

notes.title: Update -Music & Online UI-
notes.notes:
Hello! This is Toorun12, the developer of 東方凸凹遊戯.
From this update, we will write daily update not only Japanese but also in English.
Feel free to ask us for everything here if you puzzle or struggle to understand about updated contents.

We’ve just released our sixth update, once again based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

About random music
You can now favorite tracks in the “Gallery” → “Music” section.
During battles, if you have one or more songs marked with a checkmark, music will be selected at random from those.
If only one is selected, that song will always play.

Music Info
We’ve added more detailed arrangement information to several music tracks that were missing proper explanations or notes.

Display on online
We’ve added a display for current online player count on the circle located down-right corner.
Also, while you’re in the online menu, you’ll now hear a sound effect and see a live update if someone else connects.
It’s still early in release, so online activity may be low — but hopefully, this makes rare encounters easier to catch.

-----------------------------------------------------------
There are still some requests and bug reports that we haven’t addressed yet, but we’re working on them!
Here are some things currently under development:


 Support for input buffering (pre-input handling)
 Separate story mode records by difficulty level
 Minigame records by character (since performance varies)
 A “tips” system to teach advanced techniques
 New modes for online matches



If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment here, or you can join us on our official Discord:

Thanks for playing 東方凸凹遊戯! We’ll keep working hard on the next update!

notes.title: English UI Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello to all English-speaking players of 東方凸凹遊戯!
I`m Toorun12, the developer.

We’ve completed our second wave of English localization, and several new parts of the game now support English. Here’s what’s been added this time:

[olist]
 Stage rule settings window
 Character ability descriptions
 Pause menu during matches
 Post-match result menu
 challenge mode taskname
[/olist]


On this change, probably any english players can play this game (especially solo and battle in your friends) without understanding Japanese text.
Over the next week or so, we plan to add English support to most non-story UI elements.


How to switch the game to English:
(1) From the MainMenu, press the オプション(Options) button (gray button in the bottom-right).
(2) press the その他設定(Other Settings) button (furthest to the right).
(3) Look for the Language setting labeled "日本語 (Language)", and use the left/right arrows to switch.
(4) Press the 戻る(Back) button (white button at the bottom) to confirm the change — the English UI should now appear.

If you're unsure how to do this or encounter any issues, feel free to ask in the comments below!

That’s it for now — our team is back to work on the next batch of improvements. Thank you as always for your support and feedback!

notes.title: about first release
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone playing the game on Steam!

This is Toorun12 from “The Right Edge of the Phonebook.”
We initially announced that Touhou Dekoboko Yuugi would be released on May 5th…
But despite our confident declaration, it ended up taking until the end of May.
It’s already June—sorry for the delay!

This is our first time releasing a game with online multiplayer,
and—of course—we ran into all sorts of issues along the way. It’s been a ride.

Quite a few people also purchased the game as a product key at Reitaisai,
so today we’ve finally made it to the first official release. Thank you for your patience!

As listed on the store page, you can now enjoy:

Missions

Mini-games

Online battles, and more!

We’d really appreciate any feedback, especially about bugs or issues you run into.
Since we’ve only tested with a small group so far, it’s possible the online features
may struggle under heavy load—but we’re committed to updating and improving it
so everyone can enjoy the game to the fullest.

Thank you again for your support—we hope you have fun playing!
